thread:
cassie_sales: Quick presales ask for prospect 'NorthWind' — must keep inference, logs, and keys confined to EU or CA depending on tenant. They want hosted if possible; absolutely no cross-border calls even for failover. Need uplift estimate + timeline.

omar_engineer: Hosted supports tenant pinning to regional model pools (eu/ca). Important: control plane is globally managed today; full control-plane locality requires Private deployment.

sarah_privsec: Legal needs full subprocessor list for eu/ca, confirmation that audit logs are stored regionally, and BYO-KMS with regional key residency. Also need statement about metrics/telemetry — can those be filtered or redacted?

liam_ops: Ops options: 1) Hosted hard-pin (no fallback) — simplest config change but availability risk; allocate reserved capacity to mitigate. 2) Dedicated pools per region with commit — better availability. 3) Private control plane — guarantees control-plane locality but is a project.

cassie_sales: Can you give a ballpark uplift for hosted hard-pin? Customer needs to decide quickly.

omar_engineer: Ballpark numbers: hosted tenant-pin with no-fallback: +18% unit uplift. Dedicated: delta ~ +6% unit but adds monthly commit. Private/control-plane-in-region: one-time infra fee + ongoing support, timeline 4-8 weeks.

sarah_privsec: BYO-KMS caveat: for hosted we support AWS/GCP/Azure managed CMKs but if control plane is global, key policy must permit cross-region envelope calls or we deploy a regional key-proxy (adds ~1 week ops work). If customer requires absolute zero cross-border, proxy or Private needed.

liam_ops: Ops checklist for hosted hard-pin + KMS proxy: - Provision eu & ca model pools (ETA 2 wks) - Setup regional log sinks & retention (ETA 3 days) - Deploy KMS proxy (if requested) (ETA 5 business days) - Run failover tests with no-fallback config

infra-bot: TKT-78021 created: "NorthWind - provision eu/ca pinned pools + regional log sinks + optional KMS proxy"

cassie_sales: I'll propose two SOW lines: A) Hosted hard-pin (no-fallback) + 18% usage uplift, optional reserved capacity for SLA credits; B) Dedicated regional pools with custom commit pricing.

omar_engineer: Note for presales: some community/open models may not be packaged in every region due to build infra. If NorthWind requires a specific model, we must verify region availability or plan a compatible variant. I'll run a quick region-model check and post results.

sarah_privsec: I'll draft a subprocessor attestation and DPA addendum for no-cross-border. Need confirmation on where operational metrics (latency, errors) are aggregated — ops, can you confirm they can be stored in-region and excluded from global telemetry?

liam_ops: We can route operational logs and slow-path traces to regional sinks. Aggregated health metrics are global by default but can be filtered per-tenant; full in-region-only aggregation requires additional pipeline config (ETA +1 week).

cassie_sales: Great. Timeline summary for the customer: Hosted hard-pin + logs in-region: ~2-3 weeks; add KMS proxy: +1 week; Dedicated pricing numbers pending finance. I'll share the config snippet and SOW draft. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
